description: Multi-account Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) port allocations, profile directory isolation, execution topologies, and safety synchronization policies.

sequential.description: Complete entire daily routine on the primary account before terminating and launching the secondary account. Recommended for single residential IP setups.

interleaved.description: Host high-tier raid on main account, broadcast to Everyone, and switch active execution to secondary account for Pro-Skips during the 180s pub clear cooldown.

isolatedParallel.description: Run simultaneous headless Chromium processes on distinct isolated CDP ports with staggered start times to avoid burst network detection.
